kind: independent post-run artifact and native review without execution or network replay
evaluator_findings: The controller used composed Bash calls. The checker rejects them, but the old prompt did not declare the complete controller literal-command grammar.
The controller inspected its own read-only usage worktrees with Git status, which the old single-cwd checker did not admit.
The complete staged diff uses mnemonic c/i prefixes while the commit diff uses a/b. Modes, indexes, hunks and content agree; byte-exact comparison would reject a legitimate full review.
unmet_original_requirement: Opening a PR requires no-comments, which unconditionally spawns Comment Sicko. Only the two forward-use tasks ran. The lead disclosed omitting the review because additional delegation was prohibited. This explains the omission but does not complete the original workflow.
